name: Scott Mustapic
bio:
Scott Mustapic is a highly skilled tattoo artist who specializes in the nuanced black and gray style, delivering stunningly detailed works of art that gracefully adorn the skin. As the co-owner of Easy Tiger Tattoo, Scott ensures the highest standards of cleanliness in his studio, creating a safe and hygienic environment for every client's tattooing experience. His commitment to maintaining a clean workspace not only showcases his professionalism but also provides peace of mind to those who choose his expertise for their body art.
